scope: Builds .nika workflows that sync structured records to an external HTTP API while guaranteeing idempotency via a persisted state file of processed IDs. Uses credential egress, nika:fetch with idempotency-key, nika:read/nika:write for the state file, and reconcile recovery on partial failure.

scope: Solves requests that process every item of a collection one by one (typically with invoke or exec), skip the items that fail and report which succeeded and which failed. Uses for_each with on_error: { skip: true }, then pairs each input with its per-item output (null where the item failed) in one nika:jq ledger.

scope: Builds workflows that compare a source with the snapshot the previous scheduled run saved, notify only when it changed and save the new snapshot. A local source (an export another tool drops) runs unattended (block:watch-export-notify); a page or an API fetched beside the snapshot file is the lethal trifecta (NIKA-SEC-009), so a person's nika:prompt gate holds the notification and the save. The schedule is an arm entry of the project's nika.yaml with its IANA zone, never a key of the .nika file.

when: request asks to poll a URL or API and alert on any change
change detection must be deterministic (json_diff or equivalent)
notification is the only side-effect and must be gated on actual difference
when_not: one-time read or fetch without comparison (use read-known-file or fetch-page-content)
agentic research or multi-turn summarization required
alerting on one fetched value against a threshold (a price above a limit): compare it with a const, keep no snapshot file, and no person's gate is needed
